title: Touch\'{e}World tech report : Towards Online Unified Camera--Hand Exploration in Generative Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2611.06061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent video world models allow users to explore generated environments through camera navigation. Continuous hand motion provides a fine-grained action channel for interacting with the people and objects encountered during exploration. We present Touch\'{e}World, a framework that integrates gesture-driven interaction into a camera-controlled video world model. Given an initial image and a scene-description prompt, the model generates video conditioned on temporally aligned camera and hand controls. We construct joint camera--hand training data from heterogeneous egocentric videos through annotation completion, consistency-based filtering, and temporal alignment. Building on a pretrained camera-controlled world model, we combine spatial hand-skeleton conditioning with numerical hand-motion features through parameter-efficient adaptation. translated_title: TouchéWorld技术报告：面向生成世界中相机—手部统一的在线探索
translated_abstract: 最近的视频世界模型允许用户通过相机导航来探索生成的环境，而连续的手部动作为一种细粒度的动作通道，可用于与探索过程中遇到的人和物体进行交互。我们提出了TouchéWorld，一个将手势驱动交互集成到相机控制视频世界模型中的框架。给定一张初始图像和一个场景描述提示，模型以时间上对齐的相机和手部控制信号为条件生成视频。我们通过标注补全、基于一致性的过滤和时间对齐，从异构的第一人称视频中构建了相机—手部联合训练数据。在预训练的相机控制世界模型基础上，我们通过参数高效适配，将空间层面的手部骨架条件与数值化的手部运动特征相结合。因果适配与少步蒸馏支持块级在线生成，使用户能够在探索过程中（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: TouchéWorld将手势驱动的手部交互统一集成到相机控制的视频世界模型中，通过因果适配与少步蒸馏实现块级在线生成，使用户能够在生成世界中同时进行相机导航与手部细粒度交互探索。
